recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-20380 unless Patient Care later reopens the broader Flag.subject target list.
issue_request: FHIR-20380 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request asking to add PractitionerRole to Flag.subject for role-specific flags, such as flagging a practitioner in a cardiologist role rather than only the practitioner identity.
initial_application: The Jira comment cites GH#d7e990d. Commit d7e990dfb1a7d69472c86bce47f6a2ed933da942 changed the old source/flag/flag-spreadsheet.xml target list to include PractitionerRole and added the GF#20380 committee note; the later source rework carried the target into source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini lists flag=Flag as an active resource and assigns it to Patient Care. Current source/flag/structuredefinition-Flag.xml includes PractitionerRole in Flag.subject and carries committee note GF#20380, J#37950. FHIR-37950 later added RelatedPerson to Flag.subject and Flag.author; FHIR-56379 later changed Flag.supportingInfo rather than Flag.subject; FHIR-20183 declined adding ServiceRequest and NutritionOrder to Flag.subject. Patient Care minutes for 2019-02-21 list GF#20380 as resolved, and exact Zulip search for FHIR-20380 found no directly relevant thread.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current build-scoped source already implements the requested PractitionerRole target profile on Flag.subject, and no later discovered decision narrows or reverses it.

related_jiras.note: Later Published issue adding RelatedPerson to the same Flag.subject element and Flag.author, explaining the J#37950 committee note in current source. It was not separately decided in this seed run.
Resolved - No Change issue declining ServiceRequest and NutritionOrder on Flag.subject, supporting that FHIR-20380 was a narrow PractitionerRole addition.
Later Applied Flag issue adding DocumentReference and DiagnosticReport to Flag.supportingInfo, not changing the FHIR-20380 subject target.
